structure_policy_rationale: 参考支付宝（Alipay）和豆瓣（Douban）的转换案例，该主题对于文字类或几何类图标采取严格的轮廓保留策略。唯品会图标本质为纯文字Logo，其识别度完全依赖于“唯品会”三字的字形结构。因此，必须将这三个字直接转化为3D冰雕实体，保留原有的笔画粗细、转折角度和字间距，严禁重构为购物袋或标签等语义符号，以免丢失品牌身份。
preserve: “唯品会”三个汉字的完整字形与笔画结构
三字横向排列的紧凑间距与视觉重心
底部“品牌特卖”四字的辅助位置关系（若空间允许，否则弱化为纹理）
must_preserve: “唯品会”三字的准确字形轮廓
冰蓝色半透明材质与内部雪花/气泡纹理
底部的接触阴影与水迹
文字作为核心识别符号的清晰度
recompose_allowed: 原本平面的白色填充变为具有折射率的立体冰体
背景从洋红色变为纯白
底部小字“品牌特卖”可简化为微弱的底部纹理或省略，以保证主体清晰度
笔画边缘进行圆润化处理，模拟冰块打磨质感
restyle: 字体具体的衬线/无衬线风格（如改为圆体、手写体或艺术字）
背景色的材质感（如增加渐变、噪点、光泽或纹理）
文字的边缘处理（如描边、投影、立体化）
decorate: 内部嵌入雪花图案（embedded snowflakes）
内部微小气泡与冰裂纹理
forbid: 禁止保留原始的洋红色（Magenta）背景或文字颜色
禁止将文字替换为购物袋、衣服或标签等具象物体
禁止生成不透明的实心蓝色块，必须体现通透感
禁止改变“唯品会”三字的相对位置和大小比例
禁止使用英文缩写“VIP”或“VPS”代替中文
禁止使用复杂的场景背景
generation_brief: 3D ice sculpture of Chinese characters '唯品会', translucent pale cyan material, internal bubbles and snowflakes, rounded glossy edges, condensation droplets on surface, pure white background, soft contact shadow and melting water at base, high fidelity to original font structure, no magenta color, no solid opaque blocks.
color_application: Discard original magenta/red. Apply uniform pale cyan/ice blue palette. Use translucency and subsurface scattering to define form instead of flat color fills. Maintain high contrast between the ice text and white background via lighting and refraction, not hue.
stroke_application: Eliminate 2D vector strokes. Transform character boundaries into volumetric 3D ice edges with beveled, rounded corners. Define shape through light refraction and specular highlights rather than drawn lines.
composition_application: Center the extruded '唯品会' text block. Occupy 60-70% of canvas height. Remove original full-screen background. Add a subtle ground plane with contact shadow and small puddle to anchor the 3D text in space.
identity_application: Preserve the exact geometric silhouette and stroke structure of '唯品会'. Do not replace with symbols. The identity is carried entirely by the recognizable shape of the characters rendered in ice material.
fidelity_constraints: Must use unified ice-blue translucent material, strictly no original brand colors (magenta/red).
Must include internal bubbles, snowflakes, or ice-crack textures as core theme fingerprints.
Subject must exhibit 3D volume with thickness, not a flat blue silhouette.
Background must remain clean white to highlight translucency.
negative_constraints: No flat vector styles or 2D appearances.
No warm colors (red, pink, orange) or original brand magenta.
No opaque plastic, metal, or stone materials; must be translucent ice/crystal.
No distortion of the Chinese character shapes.
No replacement of text with shopping bags, clothes, or tags.
